entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1개, 1일 3회의 범위 내에서 직장내에: For adults and those 15 years of age and older, insert 1 piece into the rectum at a time, within the range of 3 times a day.
entries.심장질환, 고혈압, 갑상선질환, 당뇨병, 전립샘비대증으로 인한 배뇨곤란: Do not use this medicine if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If your symptoms do not improve after about 7 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it in children. Use this medicine only in the rectum and do not use it orally. If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has become too hard, soften it before use. Follow the prescribed directions and dosage carefully.
entries.아침 ∙ 저녁 1회 1개씩, 1일 2회 가능한 한 배변 후 항문내에 삽입: Insert 1 piece into the anus at a time in the morning and in the evening, 2 times a day, preferably after a bowel movement.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약이 무르게 된 경: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has hardened too much, soften it before use. Use this medicine only in the rectum (the large bowel) and do not use it orally.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농(곪음)성으로 인한 코막힘에 비강(코안): This medicine is used for nasal cavity irrigation for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucous discharge or purulent (suppurative) conditions.
entries.필요시 2~3시간마다 성인은 1~8회, 영아는 1회, 1개월~12개월은: When needed, spray every 2 to 3 hours: adults 1 to 8 times, newborn infants 1 time, infants 1 to 12 months of age 1 to 2 times, children 1 to 2 years of age 1 to 3 times, children 2 to 5 years of age 1 to 4 times, children 5 to 8 years of age 1 to 5 times, and children 8 to 12 years of age 1 to 6 times. For detailed directions and dosage, refer to the detailed information in the approved labeling.
